Initial release of house-skills-kit.

- Provides a framework to generate branded Chinese real estate AI advisor skills via a single configuration file.
- Supports 4 user roles (home buyer, developer sales, brokerage agent, channel distributor) and 29 attachable business modules.
- Output is brand-customized, ready-to-use markdown for large language models.
- Designed for easy configuration, modularity, and compliance with industry standards.
- All content is originally authored and aligns with best practices in skill distribution.
